description: Eki dekake: one station outing for travellers who need the elevator side and a borrowed umbrella, end to end. A six-station facility board (elevator side, umbrella point, return deadline), a borrow-to-return umbrella flow with a watched deadline, and a persistent trip record with your most-used station. Merged boutique rebuild of JP14 kasa-share and JP16 eki-barrier.
name: eki-dekake
